_comment: Allow-list for the always-on scheduling-pipeline background session. Deliberately does NOT enable the telegram plugin and the launcher passes no --channels, so this session starts no Telegram bot (avoids the 409 conflict with ClaudeTelegramService). The pipeline calls Node scripts via Bash (which internally use the TR API, A+ Playwright, and the Slack bot token), so no Slack/Playwright MCP is needed here.
